definitions.ask: Commit and push the fix mid-turn so the MacBook's own `bob plugins sync` deploys it in this turn?
definitions.why: The bug was hit on the Mac, whose bare sync pulls origin, so only a pushed fix reaches it

choices.label: The Mac gets nav 2.50.1 this turn; Bryan only reloads Obsidian
No mid-turn commit; Bryan runs `bob plugins sync` on the Mac after the commit lands
